p: violent man: Who persecutes me out of malice and without cause.
heart: That is, by their false accusations and lies, they kindle the hatred of the wicked against me.
adders' poison is under their lips: He shows the weapons the wicked use, when power and force fail them.
me: He declares the remedy of the godly, when they are oppressed by the worldlings.
hast covered my head in the: He calls to God with lively faith, being assured of his mercies, because he had before time proved, that God helped him ever in his dangers.
further not his wicked device: For it is in God's hand to overthrow the counsels and enterprises of the wicked.
the head of those that compass: It seems that he alludes to Saul.
let them be cast into the: That is by God, for David saw that they were reprobate and that there was no hope of repentance in them.
hunt the violent man to overthrow: God's plagues will light on him in such sort, that he will not escape.
dwell in thy presence: That is, will be descended and preserved by your fatherly providence and care.
